summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a transaction to simplify its corporate structure by making Brookfield Corporation Ltd. the new parent entity, listed as BN on TSX and NYSE. The meeting on July 16, 2026 approved the plan with directors elected; all nominees received strong support. The transaction is subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals, expected close by year-end 2026. No price per share, premium, or break fee was stated. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline; risk-arb focus on structural simplification and shareholder alignment.
